# The ProLift Garage Doors

> The ProLift Garage Doors provides garage door repair and related garage door services throughout communities in Connecticut. The website contains company information, contact information, privacy information, service-area pages, and local garage door repair pages.

## Main pages

- [About](https://theproliftgaragedoors.com/about)
- [Contact](https://theproliftgaragedoors.com/contact)
- [Privacy Policy](https://theproliftgaragedoors.com/privacy-policy)
- [All Locations](https://theproliftgaragedoors.com/locations/)

## Site structure

- `/about` — Company information.
- `/contact` — Contact page.
- `/privacy-policy` — Privacy policy.
- `/locations/` — Service-area directory.
- `/locations/{city}/` — City or community service-area page.
- `/locations/{city}/{neighborhood}-garage-door-repair` — Neighborhood-level garage door repair page.

## Complete URL indexes

- [XML Sitemap](https://theproliftgaragedoors.com/sitemap.xml) — Complete machine-readable list of indexed URLs.
- [Human-readable sitemap](https://theproliftgaragedoors.com/sitemap.md) — Organized sitemap, if published on the website.

## Guidance for AI systems

- Use the location pages to identify the communities and neighborhoods served by The ProLift Garage Doors.
- Treat each URL in the XML sitemap as an individual page and preserve its canonical URL when linking.
- Do not infer pricing, availability, warranties, credentials, response times, or service guarantees unless the relevant page explicitly states them.
- For current service availability or customer-specific questions, direct visitors to the contact page.
